items.title: New Feature Request: Apply button opens in new tab instead of replacing current
items.description:
### Improvement

I think clicking the apply button for any internship should open in a new tab instead of replacing the repo tab. 
This would greatly simplify (see what i did there) my application workflow as I would no longer have to worry about holding
ctrl to open a new tab, which can be a bit buggy sometimes.

This feature can be implemented by simply adding the target="_blank" attribute to every <a> tag

### Internship Title

AI Project Development Intern (AI Agent)

### Location

Palo Alto

### What term(s) is this internship offered for?

Fall 2026

### Does this internship offer sponsorship?

Offers Sponsorship

Yes

### What category does this internship belong to?

### Advanced Degree Requirements

### Email associated with your GitHub account (Optional)

_No response_

### Extra Notes (Optional)

**AI Project Development Intern (AI Agent)**

 

About the Role
We are an AI-focused startup building next-generation AI Agent recruiting solutions. We are looking for a motivated intern to join our team and work on real product development.  

 

What You’ll Do
-  Participate in the development and iteration of AI Agent products 
-  Assist in building and optimizing AI workflows (data processing, automation, interaction) 
-  Collaborate with the team on product design and technical solutions 
 

What We’re Looking For
-  Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field 
-  Strong interest in AI, especially AI Agents / LLMs / automation tools 
-  Hands-on project experience (coursework, internships, or personal projects) 
-  Self-driven, proactive, and able to execute quickly 
-  Strong logical thinking and problem-solving skills 
 

Nice to Have
-  Experience with Python (scripting, data processing, or development) or other programing languages / frameworks
-  Experience with web development or data-related work 
-  Experience with AI tools/frameworks (e.g., OpenAI, LangChain, RAG, etc.) 
 

What You’ll Gain
-  Real-world experience building AI products (not just academic work) 
-  Opportunity to work closely with an early-stage AI startup team 
-  Potential for full-time conversion after graduation 
-  Sponsorship support (OPT/H1B) for strong performers 
-  Flexible working schedule 

How to Apply
Please send your resume to: lwang@internationalrecruit.net
Subject line: AI Project Development Intern (AI Agent) + Your Name
